item.title: OpenAI delays latest model amid security concerns and industry pressure
item.description: OpenAI has held back its model, GPT-6.1 Astra, as the industry faces broader pressure to slow the development of increasingly advanced systems.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: Five men arrested on terror charges near a U.K. air base have been released on bail, the Trump administration has rolled back fuel efficiency standards for new vehicles, and more.

item.title: News outlets seek court order to halt White House access ban
item.description: Three news organizations barred from White House grounds by President Trump have asked a federal court to block the ban while the case proceeds.

item.title: Pricing expert shares four ways to avoid being overcharged
item.description: Companies have altered their pricing methods, and shoppers are being deliberately overcharged. Here are steps to ensure you are not overpaying.
